headline: Track projects, invoices, and revisions with ease
value_proposition: Bilingual Arabic and English, built for local freelancing habits, with no subscriptions that lock users in and no collection of client data.
features: Track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds using Notion and Google Sheets
Bilingual Arabic and English support for local freelancing habits
No subscriptions, no client data collected
Simple templates for Notion and Google Sheets
Helps manage multiple clients without stress

faq.q: What is included in the template pack?
faq.a: The template pack includes Notion and Google Sheets templates for tracking client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
The templates are available in Notion and Google Sheets formats.

faq.q: Can I use the templates for multiple clients?
faq.a: Yes, the templates are designed to help manage multiple clients efficiently.

faq.q: Does the product collect client data?
faq.a: No, the product does not collect any client data.
The templates are available in Arabic and English to support local freelancing habits.

claims.claim: Freelance templates in Notion include project proposals, client management tools, invoice trackers, and time management sheets.
claims.quote: Empower your freelance journey with Notion's Freelance templates. Designed for independent professionals, our collection includes project proposals, client management tools, invoice trackers, and time management sheets.

claims.claim: Freelancer estimate templates in Google Sheets are free, customizable, and printable for a polished, professional look.
claims.quote: Explore professionally designed freelancer estimate templates in Google Sheets. Free, customizable, and printable for a polished, professional look. Download now!

claims.claim: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region need a tool to manage projects and communicate with clients effectively.
claims.quote: It would help many freelance designers if I built a project management tool specifically for them! Freelance designers usually spend at least five meetings to confirm a design direction; we automate the process through survey templates.
